mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits phenytoin metabolism via CYP2C9/CYP2C19 inhibition and protein binding displacement, leading to increased phenytoin levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor phenytoin serum concentrations closely; reduce phenytoin dose by 20-30% when initiating valproic acid; monitor for signs of phenytoin toxicity (ataxia, nystagmus, sedation).
